purpose: Qualify the smallest exact transaction-safe surface-water storage and runoff ledger seam around a generic soil-face flux. This gate proves atomic accounting and event/retry semantics only; it does not qualify the full atmospheric top-boundary physics.

legacy_semantic_anchor.legacy_runoff_transfer: runots = max(pond - pondmx, 0); pond = min(pond, pondmx)
legacy_semantic_anchor.required_modern_interpretation: The excess above Smax is an explicit conservative transfer to runoff before the committed surface state is bounded. Bounding surface storage is never permission to discard or repair mass.
legacy_semantic_anchor.legacy_retry_anchor: surfacewater may set fldecdt and return; the driver retries with a reduced or event-localized dt

transaction_policy.ordinary_accept: Compute all trial state and ledgers locally, verify bounds and both mass identities, then atomically publish one new committed state.
transaction_policy.surface_overflow: If raw_surface > Smax, set runoff = raw_surface - Smax and S1 = raw_surface - runoff. This is an explicit conservative transfer, not clipping.
transaction_policy.surface_underflow: If raw_surface < 0 and q_top_rate > supply_rate, reject the full trial and return dt_event = S0/(q_top_rate-supply_rate). The committed state, time and ledgers remain bitwise unchanged.
transaction_policy.event_retry: A retry exactly to dt_event may commit S1=0 if all balances pass.
transaction_policy.post_event_rule: Continuation beyond a depletion event with the pre-event q_top is forbidden. The physical top-boundary problem must be re-solved after the event in a later gate.
transaction_policy.injected_solver_rejection: An otherwise valid locally computed trial can be rejected before publication; committed state and ledgers must remain bitwise unchanged.

deterministic_scenarios.definition: ordinary_accept one dt=0.5 versus two sequential accepted dt=0.25 trials with identical forcing and qtop; require bit-identical final committed state
one overflow dt=0.5 versus two sequential dt=0.25 trials with identical forcing and qtop; require bit-identical final state and cumulative runoff

architecture_checks.2_kernel_io_separation: Experiment contract contains no files, units or parser behavior in the calculation API.
architecture_checks.3_explicit_data_separation: Committed physical state, forcing, soil-face result, trial scratch and result ledger are distinct.
architecture_checks.4_compact_persistent_state: Only one physical surface scalar is persistent in this gate.
architecture_checks.5_scratch_per_worker: Raw trial storage, event calculation and balance intermediates are nonpersistent.
architecture_checks.7_transactional_timesteps: Rejected trials never alter committed state, time or cumulative ledgers.
architecture_checks.9_generic_time: The calculation accepts arbitrary t0 and dt; a non-midnight scenario is mandatory.
architecture_checks.13_mass_conservation_absolute: Both surface and composed-system identities must close to frozen roundoff tolerance without repair.
architecture_checks.20_alternative_soil_water_solvers: Only a generic SoilFaceResult is consumed; no Richards implementation internals are visible.
architecture_checks.22_no_headcalc_internals: Top-boundary composition knows qtop only through the soil-face contract.
architecture_checks.23_physics_solver_policy_separated: Storage capacity is physical configuration; retry/accept logic is numerical transaction policy.
architecture_checks.24_predictable_runtime: Ledger update and event localization are O(1).
architecture_checks.26_diagnostics_runtime: Accept/reject reason, event dt and exact mass residuals are explicit outputs.
architecture_checks.27_optional_functionality_scales: No optional surface modules are allocated in this restricted gate.
architecture_checks.30_change_explicitly_checked: This precommit freezes the architecture tests before execution.

hard_nonclaims: No real Richards state update is implemented or qualified in this gate.
No physical decomposition of precipitation, interception, snow, runon, irrigation or evaporation is qualified.
No post-event top-boundary mode re-solve is implemented.
No response tangent across a surface-storage or endpoint branch switch is qualified.
No full top-boundary composition, production runtime, MultiSWAP or groundwater admission follows from this gate.
The synthetic soil receiver exists only to close an executable composed mass identity and is not production state.
